aizen.Pressure Stack: Accumulated through various attacks; Techniques, Counter and last hit of Basic Attack.
aizen.Ravage: Releasing the Battlefield Skill Hado 90: Kurohitsugi or counterattacks inflicts Ravage to the enemy, reducing their All-Type Resistance for 18 seconds.
aizen.Spiritual Pressure Intimidation: Releasing Ultimate, or releasing any Battlefield Skills or landing the  last strike of the basic attack upon reaching 3 Pressure Stacks, will activate Spiritual Pressure Intimidation. During this time, interruption resitance is increased, and Perfect Dodge is auto-triggered on most imminent attacks. All Pressure Stacks gained are converted into Enhanced Pressure Stacks.
aizen.Illusion Shield: Significantly increases interruption resistance. Taking any damage consumes 1 stack to negate it and grants Invincibility for 1 second.
aizen.Kyokasuigetsu: After releasing his Ultimate, Aizen enters Kyokasuigetsu, enhancing his basic attacks and backline Battlefield Skills.
aizen.Enhanced Pressure Stacks: During Spiritual Domination, all Pressure Stacks gained by Aizen are converted into Enhanced Pressure Stacks. Releasing the Battlefield Skill Hado 90: Kurohitsugi consumes all Enhanced Pressure Stacks, granting shields to the team and counterattack effects when switching characters.
aizen.Suppression Gauge: Suppression Gauge is accumulated when other teammates attack. When the Suppression Gauge reaches its maximum, enters Complete Suppression. During this time, releasing a backline Battlefield Skill consumes all Suppression Gauge to increase its damage. The damage boost effect is further increased while Kyokasuigetsu is active.
aizen.True Time Freeze: Pauses time countdown of the stage. Timers for all buffs and states on characters and enemies will be stopped.

byakuya.True Time Freeze: Pauses time countdown of the stage. Timers for all buffs and states on characters and enemies will be stopped.

chad.Transformation Power: When Chad's HP drops below 75%, increases his Crit rate by 20% and Crit DMG by 40%. When his HP drops below 50%, increases his Crit Rate by 30% and Crit DMG by 60%.
chad.2nd Follow-up Attack: At the highest Bump DMG stage or when you release the basic attack button in advance, Chad will immediately launch a follow-up attack.
chad.True Time Freeze: Pauses time countdown of the stage. Timers for all buffs and states on characters and enemies will be stopped.

ichigo-bankai.Getsuga Mark: Ichigo's techniques inflict Getsuga Mark on the target, and his special attacks will prioritize marked enemies.
ichigo-bankai.Hollowfied: After releasing his Ultimate, Ichigo gets Hollowfied, during which all his abilities are greatly enhanced.
ichigo-bankai.Hollowfication: After releasing his Ultimate, Ichigo gets Hollowfied, during which all his abilities are greatly enhanced.
ichigo-bankai.True Time Freeze: Pauses time countdown of the stage. Timers for all buffs and states on characters and enemies will be stopped.

ichigo-shikai.Getsuga Tensho: Ichigo's signature attack — a crescent wave of condensed spiritual energy fired from his blade.

ichigo-white.Instinct Burst: After gaining 2 Instinct Points, enters Instinct Burst, increasing ATK.
ichigo-white.Instinct Point: Releasing the Battlefield Skill Crushing Rondo or a Special Attack grants 1 Instinct Point. During Instinct Burst, certain attacks can consume Instinct Points to release an extra Getsuga Tensho.
ichigo-white.True Time Freeze: Pauses time countdown of the stage. Timers for all buffs and states on characters and enemies will be stopped.

ulquiorra.Form of Void: After releasing his Ultimate, Ulquiorra enters Form of Void, increasing all of his damage. By tapping repeatedly or holding Basic Attack, he can continuously release 4 different types of Cero.
ulquiorra.Cero Mark: When releasing Basic Attacks, Special Attacks, Techniques, or Counterattacks, launches 4 different types of Cero at enemies. Each Cero activates its corresponding Cero Mark. When all 4 Cero Marks are activated, the technique is enhanced.
ulquiorra.True Time Freeze: Pauses time countdown of the stage. Timers for all buffs and states on characters and enemies will be stopped.

ulquiorra-resurreccion.Cero Mark: Release Gran Rey Cero or special attack, Worlds Apart, to gain Cero Marks. Consume 4 Cero Marks to release Cero Oscuras.
ulquiorra-resurreccion.Thunder Mark: Release Lanza del Relampago I to gain Thunder Marks. Consume 4 Thunder Marks to enter Thunderous Assault.
ulquiorra-resurreccion.Thunder Marks: Release Lanza del Relampago I to gain Thunder Marks. Consume 4 Thunder Marks to enter Thunderous Assault.
ulquiorra-resurreccion.Thunderous Assault: Releasing the Enhanced Technique, Lanza del Relampago II, enters the Thunderous Assault state. During this state, tap the Technique button repeatedly to throw Lanza del Relampago I in rapid succession.
ulquiorra-resurreccion.Reishi Rain: At the start of battle and each time Ulquiorra releases his Ultimate, Reishi Rain falls across the field, dealing damage over time.
ulquiorra-resurreccion.True Time Freeze: Pauses time countdown of the stage. Timers for all buffs and states on characters and enemies will be stopped.
